title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Terms — Cancelling, Rescheduling and No-Shows
content:
**Section 1 — Cancelling and rescheduling.** A Tailwise Grooming Salon customer may cancel or reschedule a booking; a reschedule is a cancellation of the old slot plus a new booking.

**Section 2 — Free cancellation.** A cancellation is free only if it is recorded at least the pass's free-cancellation notice before the appointment's start time. Notice is counted in full elapsed hours from the moment the cancellation is recorded to the appointment date and start time in salon local time; notice of exactly the free-cancellation notice is free. The appointment date and start time are those of the booking as held in the salon history of the pass.

**Section 3 — Late cancellation (former wording, no longer in force).** The former clause under which a late cancellation carried the pass's late-cancellation fee or, where the pass forfeits a visit for a late cancellation, forfeited one visit instead of the fee, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for late cancellations on prepaid passes and on Groom Club Monthly.

**Section 4 — Recording the remedy.** The remedy for a cancellation is recorded on the cancellation.

**Section 5 — No-shows.** A booking the pet misses, or reaches more than the pass's late-arrival grace late, is a no-show and, where the pass forfeits a visit for a no-show, forfeits one visit; no fee is added on top.

**Section 6 — Salon cancellations.** A cancellation by the salon (staff illness, closure) is never late and never forfeits anything.

**Section 7 — Once per booking.** A fee or forfeit is never charged twice for the same booking.

**Notice on the boundary (hypothetical appointment at 10:00 salon local time on a Saturday, pass with 24 hours' free-cancellation notice)**

| Cancellation recorded | Full elapsed hours of notice | Free |
|---|---|---|
| Thursday 09:00 | 25 | yes |
| Friday 10:00 | 24 | yes — exactly the notice is free |
| Friday 10:30 | 23 (23 hours 30 minutes, counted in full hours) | no |
| Saturday 08:00 | 2 | no |

**Arrival on the boundary (hypothetical, 15-minute grace)**

| Pet arrives | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 14 minutes after the start time | serviced |
| 15 minutes after the start time | serviced — not more than the grace |
| 16 minutes after the start time | no-show; one visit forfeited where the pass forfeits a visit for a no-show, with no fee on top |
| never arrives | no-show, as above |

superseded_clauses: A late cancellation carries late_cancel_fee_usd, or, where late_cancel_forfeits_visit is true, forfeits one visit instead of the fee
